learning_path.title: Python Fundamentals for Data Science
learning_path.abstract: Refresh core Python syntax and learn the structures that data work relies on: lists, dictionaries, functions, and comprehensions.

learning_path.title: Working with Pandas DataFrames
learning_path.abstract: Load tabular data into DataFrames, inspect it with head, info, describe, and select and filter rows and columns.

learning_path.title: Data Cleaning and Preparation
learning_path.abstract: Handle missing values, duplicate rows, and type inconsistencies so a raw dataset becomes analysis-ready.

learning_path.title: Exploratory Data Analysis and Visualization
learning_path.abstract: Profile distributions and relationships numerically, then communicate them with clear Matplotlib charts.

learning_path.title: Statistics and Probability for Data Science
learning_path.abstract: Build working intuition for distributions, sampling, and uncertainty using simulation before formulas.

learning_path.title: Statistical Inference and Hypothesis Testing
learning_path.abstract: Frame questions as testable hypotheses, run t-tests and chi-square tests, and read p-values honestly.

learning_path.title: SQL Fundamentals for Data Extraction
learning_path.abstract: Query relational databases with SELECT, WHERE, and GROUP BY, and pull results straight into a DataFrame.

learning_path.title: Advanced SQL Queries and Joins
learning_path.abstract: Combine tables with inner and left joins, reshape results with CTEs, and analyze patterns with window functions.
